articles.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
articles.snippet: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

articles.title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
articles.snippet: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.
